gameName: Through the Ages: A New Story of Civilization
editionLabel: Czech Games Edition English rules (Code of Laws), 2015
firstPlayerRule: Choose the starting player however you like. The starting player does not change during the game.
clarifications: Turns go clockwise from the starting player, and each round begins with the starting player's turn.
On the first turn the starting player has 1 civil action; each following player in clockwise order has one more (2, 3 or 4). Nobody has military actions on the first turn.
You may mark the starting player by sliding an unused Age A military card face down under their board.
